questions.prompt: Does this program's output end with the line D?

query.explanation: fallthrough transfers control to the body of the immediately following case only, and that body does not itself use fallthrough. So case 2 prints B, case 3 prints C, and execution leaves the switch before case 4; the last line is C, not D.
query.title: fallthrough moves to exactly one more case

questions.rationale: fallthrough enters only the next case, so the output is B then C and case 4 never runs, making D the last line impossible.
